newsitem.title: USA: Transworld Home to get $53 mln capital.
newsitem.headline: Transworld Home to get $53 mln capital.

text.p: Transworld Home HealthCare Inc said Thursday that Hyperion Partners II LP and its affiliate, Hyperion TW Fund LP, have agreed to invest an additional $52,837,488 of equity capital in Transworld at $9.875 per share, for a total of 5,350,632 shares.
The price reflects Transworld's closing price on March 26, the day the agreement was reached. The shares traded at about $10 each late Thursday morning.
The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions including, but not limited to, the approval of Transworld's senior lenders.

Transworld Home HealthCare is a regional provider of a broad range of alternate site health care services and products. It also operates a specialized mail order pharmacy and provides medical supplies to patients nationwide.
